applicability.eligible: An exact F+B-bound implementation has an exact-real-semantics-preserving finite orbit and complete declared parameter coordinates.
out_of_domain: missing exact repair or VJP transport

predictor.name: TRANSPORTED_CONDITIONAL_MEAN_PERSISTENCE
predictor.input: state-major effective-update residuals for eight semantic-orbit variants after common-state reference VJP and optimizer mapping
predictor.risk_rule: orbit-mean transported amplification exceeds its frozen norm-preserving sign-flip 95th percentile

consequence_target.positive: actual drift amplification exceeds the frozen structure-matched empirical-null 95th percentile

heldout_sequence: enumerate every actual F+B invocation and deduplicate exact implementations without numerical consequence values
label SEEN_EXACT_IMPL_NEW_OPERANDS, NEW_EXACT_IMPL_SEEN_PATTERN, NEW_IMPL_PATTERN, or NEW_SEMANTIC_FAMILY
measure predictor on every eligible new representative and commit risk/control/OOD predictions

counting.deep_measurement: one representative per exact implementation identity

claim_boundary: This freezes a falsifiable source-persistence predictor, not a universal all-operator safety oracle. Feedback-sustained and discrete-routing regimes are separate outputs.
